title: Concurrent first calls on a new store race its policy initialization and one fails
outcome: Concurrent first calls on a new store race its policy initialization and one fails
acceptance: Two or more concurrent first words on a store that has never been opened all succeed (or one waits for the other's initialization), with no UNIQUE constraint failure; a regression test covers it

completion.summary: Concurrent first opens of a new store all succeed: open reads every probe in one snapshot; the core schema, initial policy and work schema commit in one transaction; under the cold write lock the open re-probes and restarts once if another opener initialized the store (a second time is a busy-typed refusal); the WAL switch is retried within the busy timeout outside any transaction. Regression tests stage 2 and 3 openers, three concurrent first `add` words, a commit between probes, a foreign table, and a pre-commit failure. Landed in bundle 11 as 92fc3d0 with w-0717569bf3df; gate test-87fa54f3 PASS 9/9 on freeze f4deb8f3…1041; review round 2 clean; independent evaluation passed 1/1.
